references: The Milwaukee Bucks defeated the visiting Atlanta Hawks, 144 - 112, at Fiserv Forum on Friday. Milwaukee came into this matchup as a sizable favorite and this scoreline shows just why. The first quarter really set the tone, as they outscored Atlanta, 43 - 14, en route to a wire - to - wire win. The domination didn't end there though, as they led by 33 points at the half and by 39 points heading into the fourth quarter. The shooting disparity was key, with Milwaukee hitting 55 percent of their shots while holding Atlanta to just 44 percent from the field. The Bucks also outrebounded the Hawks, 53 - 32, while out - assisting them, 36 - 26. Milwaukee also won the points in the paint battle, 74 - 40, while winning the fastbreak points differential, 34 - 19. The Hawks (11 - 27) were led by DeAndre' Bembry, as he provided 19 points and two rebounds off the bench. DeWayne Dedmon led the starters with 14 points and two assists. Trae Young was their best player, as he tallied 13 points, three rebounds, 10 assists and two steals. John Collins finished with 12 points, seven rebounds, two assists and two steals. The Bucks (27 - 10) had all 12 players score at least eight points, as Khris Middleton led the team with 19 points, four assists and three steals. Malcolm Brogdon matched those 19 points, adding three rebounds and two assists to his tally. Giannis Antetokounmpo accumulated 16 points, eight rebounds and 10 assists while Eric Bledsoe totaled 14 points, eight rebounds and two assists. Ersan Ilyasova led the bench with 10 points and 10 boards. On deck for Milwaukee is a home matchup versus the Toronto Raptors on Saturday. As for Atlanta, they return to action on Sunday when they play host to the Miami Heat.
